text_block_list.text:
While having lunch in the cafeteria, from 
the TV monitor mounted on the wall—

text_block_list.name: TV Program
text_block_list.text:
"—The final day of close coverage on 
Duramente. On that day, she participated 
in an event race hosted by the television 
network."

text_block_list.name: Documentary Staff
text_block_list.text:
In a race featuring horse girls chosen by 
fan vote... Duramente-san was the 3rd 
favorite.

text_block_list.name: Documentary Staff
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... having followed her up 
close until today, I personally couldn't 
help but feel dissatisfied with that.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: However, there is no issue whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No matter the circumstances, —what must be 
done remains singular.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, upon the stage that opened, we 
were... forcefully shown the true essence 
of those words."

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Here comes the final corner! Every horse 
girl spurt in unison... —Wait, what's 
this?!"

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Duramente has been bumped wide! Duramente 
gets heavily blown to the outside! 
Duramente is now burdened with a massive 
disadvantage!"

text_block_list.name: Documentary Staff
text_block_list.text:
...gh! ...No, even so! Even so—if it's 
Duramente-san...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (—No problem.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (Effort.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: (Aptitude.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: In this strength—there is no flaw!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"...Under 200 meters to go! The leader is 
holding on desperately from the inside, 
but...! —Here comes Duramente from the 
outside!"

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Unbelievable, from the outside! It's 
Duramente! Just how strong is Duramente?! 
...Crossing the line in 1st place for the 
GOAL!"
(WOOOOAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Documentary Staff
text_block_list.text:
D-Duramente-san, Duramente-san! 
Congratulations...! Truly! Truly, what a 
magnificent race!

text_block_list.name: Documentary Staff
text_block_list.text:
You will undoubtedly become a horse girl 
whose name goes down in history! ...Going 
forward, how do you intend to carve that 
name?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —I will win.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Win again and again. Win overwhelmingly. 
Win flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: And then... I will prove it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As a scion of a bloodline that has 
continually demonstrated 'the strongest.' 
That I alone am the one and only 
'strongest'...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I will prove that I am 'the world's 
strongest.'
(WOOOOAAAHHH!!)
"—Fufu. Big words, aren't they?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Though, I won't let it happen so easily. 
On the pride of the Satono family, 
absolutely never.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I won't lose either. I'll run beyond 
Duramente-san's speed, and bring smiles to 
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I... I don't want... to be the only one 
left behind...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...'Proof of the strongest', huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Effort, aptitude, and plenty of raw skill! 
—But just that alone isn't quite enough, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. Predicting that achieving her 
objective will require some form of 
external factor.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, if she is able to acquire it... 
—She will truly have the potential to 
become 'the strongest.'

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
... Don't just jump into the conversation 
like you belong here.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aw, why not! ...I'm really excited to see 
if she can find 'that something'!

—And so, through the close-coverage 
documentary, Duramente made her name 
resonate far and wide.

text_block_list.text:
